Subject: Pinecrest MAP: evaluation & dedicated-reservation close plan

Hi Emma / Marco —

Following our demo last week, attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a preliminary capacity worksheet that maps your expected peak throughput to a dedicated GPU pool. High-level ask: can we align on a pilot evaluation window and a target close date so we can hold the specific GPU pool for Pinecrest?

Key points in the attached MAP (Pinecrest_MAP_v1.2.pdf):
- Week 0–2: Eval kickoff, baseline traces, 2-day perf run with a 2-node pool (4xA100 equivalent)
- Week 3–6: Pilot (production-like load, KV/prefix caching validated) — tradeoff tuning and quantization test
- Ramp: commit to reserved capacity at Month 1 post-pilot with a 6–12 month term; optional burst pool for seasonal spikes

Pricing/commits we propose (high level):
- 6-month term: 10% discount on hosted list, baseline reserved capacity pricing
- 12-month term: 18% discount + capacity guarantees (SLA bump)
- Burst clause: up to 30% burst available at a 1.5x per-token surcharge unless pre-bought burst credits are committed (negotiable)

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm the pilot sizing expectation (I attached capacity-estimate-olga.xlsx with two scenarios: 4xA100 equiv and 8xA100 equiv)
2) Tell us the internal signoff timeline and procurement lead time (DocuSign/PO cadence)
3) Any non-negotiable security/compliance items we should include in the MAP (we included SOC2 excerpt)

If you can, please review and reply with any redlines by end of next week so we can aim for a close in mid-March. I can hop on a 30-min call to walk through.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov

Thanks, Olga — this is helpful. Quick clarifying Qs after a skim:

- Pilot sizing: our infra team expects production to land between the two scenarios; leaning toward the 8xA100 equiv for headroom during model updates. Can you confirm if the pilot can run with the 8x equivalent?
- Burst: Pinecrest legal prefers a hard cap on unexpected overage charges. Would Redwood be open to a negotiated cap at 15% burst at time-and-material rates, with pre-buy credits for additional burst?
- Discounts: the table is fine but can we see an explicit example invoice for 12-month term with an 18% discount and expected monthly commitment so procurement has line items?

Procurement timeline: we have a QBR on 3/2 where we need an internal proposal. If we can get final pricing + MAP by 2/25, we can aim to sign by 3/12. Security: SOC2 excerpt is appreciated; we will follow up with a short vendor questionnaire next week.

Would appreciate a short call Friday to walk through the capacity workbook.

—Emma

Proposal A (Conservative) — 4xA100-equivalent pool (2 nodes):
- Baseline throughput: ~60 tok/sec sustained per node, KV cache enabled
- Reserved monthly rate: $XX,XXX (list) -> 6-month term: 10% discount; 12-month: 16% discount

- Reserved monthly rate: $YY,YYY (list) -> 6-month: 12% discount; 12-month: 20% discount + priority capacity during region contention

Call: I can run through the spreadsheet Friday 2/20 at 10:00am PT. Olga, Marissa: can you confirm?
